text:
emma_finance: Heads up — Invoice 99421 (AcmeCorp) appears to include the platform fee twice during the Jan migration window. Snippet from the invoice:

```
INV: 99421
Date: 2026-01-31
Customer: AcmeCorp
Line 101: LEGACY-SKU (Platform Fee)   $15,000
Line 102: PRIVATE-SKU (Platform Fee)  $15,000
Support Tier: Enterprise (01/01–01/31)
Proration flag: false
Notes: migration active Jan 10–Jan 24 (reported by CSM)
```

luis_accounting: Can you confirm which contract clause controls platform fee application? My read of the SOW is "one platform fee per active customer deployment" so overlap should be prorated, not double-billed.

olivia_csm: Confirmed — we have a signed change order that documents the private deploy go-live on Jan 10 and legacy retirement on Jan 25. Customer explicitly asked for single platform fee and proration during the overlap. I've added the CO record in SFDC.

raj_sales: For context: we flipped PRIVATE-SKU live on Jan 10 and only stopped the legacy routing on Jan 25. So overlap = 15 days (10–24 inclusive). Customer has already asked for a credit to the next invoice.

billing-bot: Invoice 99421 created by billing-service at 1749998890. Status: issued.

emma_finance: Quick calc: one platform fee = $15,000 for 31 days. Overlap 15 days => credit = 15000 * 15/31 = $7,258.06 (rounded to $7,258). Proposal: issue credit memo of $7,258 against the PRIVATE-SKU platform fee line and mark invoice adjusted. @luis_accounting please approve.

luis_accounting: Approve the credit amount, but we need the CO link in the invoice notes and an Ops ticket so AR can apply the memo. @olivia_csm can you paste the SFDC CO ID and confirm overlap dates in billing notes?

olivia_csm: CO attached in SFDC (CO-2026-0112). Confirmed overlap dates in billing notes: "Migration overlap 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-24 (15 days) — customer agreed to single platform fee prorated." Ticket created: BILLING-4127.

raj_sales: Customer prefers credit vs refund. They asked for it to be applied to next month's invoice.

emma_finance: I'll raise the credit memo (CM-7865), set invoice 99421 status to "adjusted" and note apply-to-next-invoice. Will notify AR and cc Billing Ops. ETA: EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

luis_accounting: Thanks — please tag me on the AR update.

emma_finance: Will do. Closing loop once CM applied.
